added_failure_derivation: The reviewed run's manifest block records baseline_suite: null and after_suite: null (confirmed in the run's classification.json manifest.data), so no suite gate log exists from which added failures could be derived; the node's write paths reach no test path. added_failure_count is therefore 0 on a measured absence of suite logs, not on a green suite.

durability.reason: evidence runner for one operational measure: its verify() keys on member presence and misses a null score, but the page and manifest report the unscored midplane member correctly and the node is a record, not a guard; the unscored member is resolved by the lead's rebind-and-retire ruling

reuse.reason: the measurement extends its owners (harmonize.docs_score_regressions, graph_cost_and_claims.aggregate_calls_per_phase); the duplicated fragment scaffolding across evidence runners is a known pattern not worth a product module for single-use records

findings.summary: The missing-score guard tests key membership, so a null score passes it
findings.text: missing = [m for m in members if m not in scores_b or m not in scores_a] tests key presence, but both halves of this record carry electrostatic_potential_at_outboard_midplane with the value null, so the member's key is present and the guard cannot see the very unscored member the page reports at shc-locus-reapply-all-bindings.html:6; a record where a member is unscored and nothing fell would exit 0 from verify() while the page calls the family non-converged.

findings.summary: fixture() is defined but never run and never asserted, and the delivered record carries no fixture key
findings.text: fixture() writes payload['fixture'] and asserts docs_score_regressions names a below-threshold member, but the delivered shc-locus-reapply-all-bindings.json has no fixture key and verify() at line 1068 never reads one, so the plan's clause that the comparison be shown able to see a regression is unattested by this node's evidence; sibling shc-three-family-measure-results.json carries it instead.

findings.summary: roster_check and five other helpers are byte-identical copies of the sibling fragment's
findings.text: roster_check, _CostServices, _fmt, _id, read_results and write_results are byte-identical to shc-locus-converge-remeasure-run.py:91 and its siblings, making this the twelfth near-duplicate evidence script in the directory; no product module owns the fragment-scaffolding capability, and the measurement itself does extend the owners (imas_codex/standard_names/harmonize.py:1375 docs_score_regressions, imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_cost_and_claims.py:130 aggregate_calls_per_phase).

justifications.durability: shc-locus-reapply-all-bindings-run.py:1125 checks member score presence by key membership, so the null score the delivered record carries for electrostatic_potential_at_outboard_midplane passes the gate's own missing-score guard; the one assertion that did fire is the fell comparison at line 1127.
justifications.evidence: shc-locus-reapply-all-bindings-run.py:1068-1166 verify() asserts cost against the cap, the roster scope, per-binding answers on every vetoed claim, both snapshots and the fell set, and its EXIT=1 is recorded in the run's verify.log beside EXIT=0 apply-1.log and two dry-run logs.
justifications.fit: shc-locus-reapply-all-bindings-run.py:1-24 follows the module-docstring and subcommand idiom of its sibling shc-locus-converge-remeasure-run.py and imports measurement from the product owners rather than re-deriving it.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-harmonize-command/shc-locus-reapply-all-bindings.html:4-6 records the dry runs, per-member before/after documentation scores, per-name cost, lint by kind before and after, the veto record and the out-of-family check, and states the convergence verdict as no.
justifications.reuse: shc-locus-reapply-all-bindings-run.py:91 roster_check, together with _CostServices, _fmt, _id, read_results and write_results at lines 69-110, is byte-identical to shc-locus-converge-remeasure-run.py:91 etc., a twelfth copy of evidence-fragment scaffolding the directory already holds eleven times.
